# Copilot Instructions

- Project: Vite + React 19 + TS + Supabase todo app. Routing and providers are wired in [../src/App.tsx](../src/App.tsx); data is driven by Supabase with React Query cache in [../src/libs/queryClient.ts](../src/libs/queryClient.ts).
- Install/run: `bun install`; env vars `VITE_SUPABASE_URL` and `VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` in `.env`; start local Supabase via Docker (`npx supabase init && npx supabase start`) and apply [../sample-db.sql](../sample-db.sql) plus enable Realtime on the `tasks` table per [../README.md](../README.md). Dev server: `bun run dev`; build: `bun run build`; lint: `bun run lint`.
- Path alias: `@/*` maps to `src/*` (see [../tsconfig.app.json](../tsconfig.app.json)); prefer it for imports.
- Auth: Supabase auth context lives in [../src/context/AuthContext.tsx](../src/context/AuthContext.tsx); it fetches the current user on mount and listens to `onAuthStateChange`. Access via `useAuth` ([../src/hooks/useAuth.tsx](../src/hooks/useAuth.tsx)); avoid reading Supabase auth directly in components.
- Routing: `BrowserRouter` with `/` (home), `/login`, and `/dashboard`. Wrap protected areas in [../src/ProtectedRoute.tsx](../src/ProtectedRoute.tsx); it shows a loading spinner until auth resolves and redirects unauthenticated users to `/login`.
- Data model: `tasks` table rows match [../src/types/task.ts](../src/types/task.ts) (`id`, `text`, `created_at`, `user_id`). Queries/mutations are scoped to the current `user.id`; keep that filter on any new Supabase calls.
- Data fetching: `useGetTasks` ([../src/hooks/useGetTasks.tsx](../src/hooks/useGetTasks.tsx)) uses React Query (`queryKey: ["tasks"]`) and a Supabase channel `tasks-changes` for realtime inserts/updates/deletes, updating the cache via `queryClient.setQueryData`. If you add fields, update the cache mapping functions accordingly.
- Mutations: `useAddTask` inserts with the current `user.id` and trims empty input; `useDeleteTask` deletes by id; `useSignOut` signs out via Supabase. Use these hooks from UI (see [../src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx](../src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx)) and supply `onSuccess/onError` for toast feedback.
- UI patterns: Tailwind utility classes and React Icons for visuals; toast notifications via `react-toastify` (mounted in [../src/App.tsx](../src/App.tsx)). Forms use `react-hook-form`; follow that pattern for validation/state. Layout wrapper in [../src/pages/Layout.tsx](../src/pages/Layout.tsx) provides the page container/background.
- Dashboard flow (see [../src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx](../src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx)): loads tasks with `useGetTasks`, adds via textarea + `useAddTask`, deletes with `useDeleteTask`, and signs out using `useSignOut`. Realtime updates mean the list stays synced without manual refetch.
- Home/login: Public marketing-ish home in [../src/pages/HomePage.tsx](../src/pages/HomePage.tsx); auth UI in [../src/pages/LoginPage.tsx](../src/pages/LoginPage.tsx) supports email/password sign-in/up and Google OAuth (`supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth`). When auth succeeds, it navigates to `/dashboard` and fires a success toast.
- Styling: Tailwind v4 is used via the Vite plugin; keep new styles in JSX classes (no bespoke CSS). Keep the clean, card-like aesthetic and gradient headers used in dashboard/login.
- Error handling: Hooks throw Supabase errors; surfaces are toasts in pages. If you add mutations, return/throw Supabase errors so callers can toast or display them consistently.
- Testing/dev notes: No test suite present; rely on manual checks. When changing Supabase interactions, verify realtime subscriptions clean up (see cleanup in `useGetTasks` return) and ensure new fields are projected in select/insert payloads.
- Adding features: Prefer new hooks under [../src/hooks](../src/hooks) that wrap Supabase + React Query; expose them to pages. Keep routes declared in [../src/App.tsx](../src/App.tsx) and protect with `ProtectedRoute` when they depend on auth.
